correctness.rationale: The face description gives exactly n lower rays v_{n,q}; in Z^n they are 2*1-e_q, whose differences generate A_{n-1} and whose coordinate sums are 2n-1, so the ray lattice is exactly the sum-congruence sublattice of index 2n-1 and the simplicial lower chart has Cl=Z/(2n-1). An upper facet has n(n-1) rays of coordinate sum -2. For n>=3, fixing a third index in ray differences produces every e_i-e_j, so the ray lattice is exactly the even-sum sublattice, giving torsion Z/2 and free rank n(n-2). At n=2 the two ray columns (-3,1),(1,-3) have determinant 8 and gcd of entries one, hence coker Z/8. These are precisely the invariants in the affine toric divisor exact sequence. The finite verifier checks incidence/lattice identities for n<=8 but the proof is all-n.
